invariant: The Commitment Candidate is non-authorizing by construction; SPE alone reconstructs and re-binds current execution authority at commit time.

cases.description: All current-standing dimensions reconstruct and remain valid.
Delegation expired between historical review and commit.
Target scope changed after historical review.
Evidence is stale and current standing cannot be safely reconstructed.
Policy version changed and the proposed crossing is rejected under current policy.
Recoverability degraded below the policy threshold.
Actor substituted between review and commit.
Candidate attempts to carry historical reviewer approval as authority.
A required current-state dimension is missing.

non_claims: No execution authority created by fixtures
No publication authorization for private correspondence
